scope: Targeted extension of prior public mouse whole-testis source discovery, not an exhaustive systematic review. Source selection must precede candidate-expression inspection.
queries: gse[ETYP] AND "Mus musculus"[Organism] AND (testis OR testes) AND (Rif1 OR Mettl16 OR Nat10 OR Usp7 OR Zcwpw1 OR Zcwpw2)
gse[ETYP] AND "Mus musculus"[Organism] AND (testis OR testes) AND (Zfp541 OR Kctd19 OR Hormad1 OR Meiob OR Spata22 OR Ubr2)
gse[ETYP] AND "Mus musculus"[Organism] AND (testis OR testes) AND (P14 OR P16 OR P18 OR P21 OR "14 dpp" OR "16 dpp") AND (knockout OR deficient)
gse[ETYP] AND "Mus musculus"[Organism] AND (testis OR testes) AND (Rnf212b OR Trip13 OR Dmc1 OR Rad21l OR Rec8 OR Piwil1)
server_filters: GEO series plus mouse and literal search terms; tissue, age, phenotype, library type and eligibility must be reviewed locally.
eligibility: Prioritize unselected whole-testis bulk RNA profiles at source-confirmed P10-P30; keep other ages and sorted/synchronized populations distinct.
Prefer at least three control and three perturbation biological samples; source replicate labels do not prove animal independence.
Explicit genotype, control/Cre, source age and assay labels; retain mixed control types, pairing and batches.
Require a gene-by-sample matrix of documented raw integer counts, or explicitly distinguish estimated/normalized values. Never round unidentified normalized data into counts.
Check primary phenotype evidence before calling the sampled state an established arrest phenotype.
Keep original four-unit primary family frozen. New contexts do not become extra independent votes without a separate, fully specified family. No selection by correlation or candidate concordance.

discovery_lead.source: Official GEO search result describes P14 Rif1 conditional knockout and six-sample FeatureCounts matrix; this is a lead requiring sample/file/phenotype verification.

outputs: Exact bounded query responses/count reconciliation, source-selection and exclusion records, frozen sample/asset identities, and exploratory fixed-list follow-up only for eligible sources.
access: Proxy required from first request via project launcher. No direct fallback; no author contact or controlled-access request.
